title: Is a job guarantee the solution to mass AI unemployment?
hook_text: Could a job guarantee fix AI unemployment?
script:
A government job guarantee is emerging as a proposed fix for mass AI unemployment.
Advocates argue the state should step in as an employer of last resort.
As generative algorithms replace office workers, traditional safety nets risk failing completely.
Economists suggest funded public works could absorb millions of displaced workers.
Would you rely on a state-backed job if automation replaces your position?
